correctness.rationale: Reconstruction: all types are distinct circular gap orientation vectors; gaps after parameters and antipodes have degrees s and n-s; closed-walk crossing balance establishes symmetric parameter scores; the resulting polynomial is (1+z)S. Each transitive triple has one vertex beating both others, yielding the exact variance shift by directed triangle count. Majorization and integer convexity prove sharp extrema with explicit regular and near-regular circular realizations. 4,283 direct finite parameter checks and 8,190 antipodal-word checks corroborate without proving the all-n theorem. Main dependency: classical Brouwer circular representation and Fraisse homogeneity.
